Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (2160p 4K)​


​
Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour is a 2026 American concert film directed and produced by James Cameron and singer-songwriter Billie Eilish. The film stars Eilish and features performances from her seventh headlining concert tour, Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (2025), in Manchester. It is Eilish's third concert film succeeding Happier Than Ever: A Love Letter to Los Angeles (2021) and Billie Eilish: Live at the O2 (2023). The concert film premiered at the Fox Westwood Village Theater on May 6, 2026, and was theatrically released by Paramount Pictures on May 8, 2026.
